rhoFit: Conditional weighted likelihood with fixed shrunk Poisson rates; bisection to 1e-10, positive tau cells required. Refit using only dates strictly before each prediction day.
calibration: League, model, period, outcome and fixed probability deciles; sample sizes and Wilson intervals. Bins below 30 observations flagged descriptive-only.
comparison: All four declared variants retained. Primary comparison uses identical matches across variants; own coverage and paired closing-odds coverage also retained.
limitations: The original baseline evaluation for 2025/26 was already observed before this comparison. This is chronological retrospective research, not an untouched selection holdout.
Dixon-Coles correction is conditional on existing Poisson rate estimates; this does not reproduce the external repository's joint maximum-likelihood attack/defence fit.
No hyperparameter search or automatic production model selection. Probabilities are not PnL; no Polymarket execution, fees or gas are measured by these result CSVs.
Candidate calibration and sizing are unapproved; production retains poisson-clubs-v1 and its existing paper limits.
